title: The Joy of Connection: 5 Ways T‑Mobile Members Can Make This Season Merrier
summary: Whether you’re road-tripping to Grandma’s or hosting the whole crew, T‑Mobile members get more out of the season. Here's how.
body_markdown:
Some spend December chasing frequent flyer miles. Others are seven stores deep in the search for a NeeDoh, logging hours watching holiday movies or just trying to keep the house in one piece, Kevin McCallister style.


However you celebrate, there’s no single right way to make the season merry. With T‑Mobile, members have five ways to make it their own and stay connected to what matters most.


## 1. How Can You Build Your Perfect Holiday Mix?


Your holiday plans probably don’t look like your neighbor’s, and your wireless benefits shouldn’t have to either. The person counting down to kickoff wants something different than the person counting down to the next episode.


With T‑Mobile’s all-new[T-Mix plans](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/un-carrier/t-mobile-introduces-tmix) , members get more choice in the[benefits included in their wireless plan](https://www.t-mobile.com/dialed-in/wireless/phone-carrier-benefits) , with the flexibility to change them as their needs evolve. T-Mix plans — Standard, More and Loaded — come with Picks, which members can use to choose the benefits they want from a[lineup](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits) including Apple Music, Apple TV, Delta SkyMiles, DashPass by DoorDash, ESPN Unlimited, Google Gemini, Hulu, Netflix, Pandora, Paramount+, SiriusXM, XBOX Game Pass and YouTube Premium.


Whether it’s capturing holiday memories with the incredible camera system on iPhone 18 Pro, streaming holiday favorites on Apple TV, jamming to festive playlists on Apple Music, staying connected with loved ones over video with Optimized Video Calls or earning miles toward their next getaway with Delta, members can build their[perfect mix](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/offers/how-t-mix-fits-every-kind-of-t-mobile-member) and make the season their own.


And when the season changes, your mix can too. Members can switch up their Picks quarterly throughout the year without changing plans, while still enjoying the T‑Mobile perks that come standard, like access to[America’s](https://www.t-mobile.com/coverage/network)[Best Network](https://www.t-mobile.com/coverage/network?INTNAV=tNav%3ACoverage%3ANetwork) , weekly deals and freebies with[T‑Mobile Tuesdays](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/t-mobile-tuesdays) ,[exclusive travel benefits](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/travel) ,[premium experiences at events nationwide](https://www.t-mobiletickets.com/) and[more](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits) .


## 2. Want to Unwrap a Little Something Special Every Day?


Holiday shopping is already well underway, and T‑Mobile has 12 more reasons to keep checking your list.


Starting Dec. 1, members can unlock a new accessory deal every single day in the[T-Life app](https://www.t-mobile.com/apps) with 12 Days of Magenta, an exclusive event for members featuring limited-time drops and special pricing. Each deal stays live through Dec. 12 while supplies last, and a grand finale is waiting under the magenta tree.


Consider it a members-only advent calendar for your holiday shopping list, with tech accessories across charging, protection, gaming, audio and more. Take a first look now, then check back daily in T-Life or at[T‑Mobile.com/12days](https://www.t-mobile.com/12days) beginning Dec. 1. Who knows, maybe you’ll even get to spoil yourself while you shop.


## 3. Care to Give Your Holiday Spending a Little Something Back?


It starts with one gift. Then come the groceries, the flights and the dinner reservation grabbed at the last minute. Holiday spending adds up fast.


The[T‑Mobile Visa®](https://www.t-mobile.com/cards/visa-credit-rewards) credit card gives that spending a second job: earning rewards while you wrap up the to-do list. Eligible cardholders earn 2% in rewards on every purchase, 5% in rewards on any phone, device or accessory purchases at T‑Mobile and they can redeem rewards toward a new phone, device, accessory or their T‑Mobile bill. With[T‑Mobile’s holiday deals](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/offers/black-friday-gets-a-magenta-makeover) on the[latest phones](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/apple-iphone-deals) and more, now is a great time to stack those rewards on top of the savings.


Also, T‑Mobile Visa is the only credit card eligible for the T‑Mobile AutoPay discount. Consider it a thank-you for the shopping you were doing anyway.


[Tech the Halls with T‑Mobile’s Gift Guide](https://www.t-mobile.com/devices/tech-gifts)


## 4. What T‑Mobile Travel Perks Can Make Holiday Trips Easier?


Your holiday itinerary may be complicated enough. Staying connected shouldn’t have to be, especially when the season sends people everywhere, from across town to across the globe. AAA projects[81.5 million](https://newsroom.aaa.com/2026/11/aaa-thanksgiving-holiday-travel-forecast/) people will travel at least 50 miles from home over the Thanksgiving holiday period alone, and T‑Mobile members can make sure the trip doesn’t cost them their connection or their budget.


Members can get up to[40% off hotels and pay-now car rentals](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/travel) , plus a free premium drink on all qualifying Delta flights. Just link your Delta SkyMiles® and T‑Mobile accounts through T-Life to start sipping.


Members also get[free in-flight Wi-Fi](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/travel/in-flight-wifi) on eligible Delta, Alaska, Hawaiian and Southwest flights, so staying in touch from takeoff to touchdown doesn’t cost extra. And for anyone dreaming bigger than a holiday road trip, eligible members can receive $2,500 in annual T‑Mobile Cruise Credits.


## 5. Ready to Bundle Up This Winter?


When family or friends visit for the holidays, they bring the gifts, the appetites and every device they own. That means phones, tablets, laptops and plenty of questions about the Wi-Fi password. Between streaming holiday classics, video calls with faraway loved ones and gaming consoles all running at once, your home internet ends up carrying a lot of the season.


**Need to get connected quickly?**[T‑Mobile 5G Home Internet](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet) offers free[same-day delivery](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet/doordash-same-day-internet) powered by DoorDash in eligible areas. The equipment can be at your door within hours, and you can be online in as little as 15 minutes. It works for wireless customers too, so a new device and home internet can show up the same day. With plans starting at $30/month when paired with a voice line and AutoPay (plus taxes and fees), right now members can save $20/month, plus get a multi-year price guarantee and can also score one month free and up to $200 back this holiday season.


**Considering fiber for your home?**[T‑Mobile Fiber](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet/fiber) offers another way to keep up with a busy household, with plans starting at $35/month with AutoPay (plus taxes and fees). There’s no voice line required for the best pricing, so it’s an easy add for any household. For homes looking for even more speed, Fiber 5 Gig is available at $90/month with AutoPay (plus taxes and fees), a 10-year price guarantee, plus two months free and $300 in virtual prepaid cards, so you can treat yourself after the last guest heads home.


*Whatever your season looks like, here’s to more joy and a lot more connection. Happy holidays!*
